title: First-variation bound |δW(X)| ≤ sup|X|·‖δW‖(K) for C¹ fields supported in a compact K ⊆ U
statement: Let W be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N with locally bounded first variation, K ⊆ U compact, X : ℝ^N → ℝ^N a C¹ vector field with tsupport X ⊆ K, and B ∈ ℝ with |X(z)| ≤ B for all z. Then |δW(X)| ≤ B·‖δW‖(K), i.e. ofReal|W.firstVariation X| ≤ ofReal B · variationMeasure W K in [0,∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U) (X : Euclidean N → Euclidean N) (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (B : ℝ), W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → tsupport X ⊆ K → (∀ z, ‖X z‖ ≤ B) → ENNReal.ofReal |W.firstVariation X| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B * variationMeasure W K
